comment: Pet attack VFX flipbook sheets: 4x4 grid (16 frames, left-to-right then top-to-bottom) at 1024x1024, rendered by blender/vfx/render_textures.py into blender/vfx/out/<key>.png. tint 'baked' = the element colour is in the texture (use a white / near-white Color in game); tint 'runtime' = white / neutral shapes meant to be coloured with ParticleEmitter.Color or Beam.Color. Transparent pixels are RGB (30, 38, 72). Checked by tools/vfx_textures_check.py.

textures.use: flickering cartoon flame tongue: fire burst, flame spear body, fire rain
a cluster of embers rising and flickering: ember trail, embers swirling on heat
a cartoon smoke puff that swells then breaks up (neutral grey, tint dark warm grey for Flame)
crown splash bursting up and falling apart: geyser burst, wave slash impact
one water droplet that wobbles, squashes on landing, bounces and pops
ground ripple rings spreading out (flat decal / particle facing up)
a faceted ice shard tumbling: crystal shatter debris, shard trail
a six-armed snowflake turning and twinkling: snow trail, hail
a pale frost mist puff with glints that swells and fades: frost ring, melt
pink and yellow petals fluttering (outlined so they read on green grass): petal trail, heal spirals
two leaves tumbling with a bright rim: root burst debris
a thorny vine whip streak that lashes across and fades
voxel rock chunks tumbling (toon-shaded cubes): impact chunks, boulder debris
a sandy dust puff with grit specks that swells and thins: dust trail, ground slam
ground crack decal spreading out from the centre with a glowing seam
a jagged vertical lightning bolt with branches, new shape every frame
zig-zag electric spark crackles (tint blue for Storm, purple for Shadow's glitchy sparks)
a billowing cartoon cloud with flashes inside (neutral grey: tinted per element for the Storm special)
a plump five-point star spinning and twinkling: shooting star, star burst, falling stars
a burst of golden light rays shooting out and thinning
a four-point glint that pops and turns: sparkle tail, heal plus-sparkles
curling purple shadow wisps: dark claw wisps, shadow orb
a void ring collapsing inward with streaks pulled to the centre: void implosion
black glass shards with purple edges tumbling: the glass shatter
a crescent slash arc sweeping round and dissolving: every melee swipe
a shockwave ring expanding and thinning: blasts, rally pulses, slams
a soft round glow that breathes: charge glow, orb halo, impact flare
a tapered spark streak with a hot head (horizontal, head on the right)
horizontal speed lines rushing past: haste, pounce afterimage
a round honeycomb shield face with a ripple of light running across it
